ward of Caroline Vernon Harcourt

Sister of the 3rd Viscount St.

Vincent, her mother died in 1828, and she was orphaned 1839; she was a ward of Caroline Vernon Harcourt; she was given the precedence of a Viscount's daughter in 1860 [PB, will of Caroline Vernon Harcourt, 1881 census]
